text:
arjun: FYI alert just fired — p95/p99 for chat-generation on prod increased sharply around 03:05 UTC. Customers reporting timeouts. I'm opening the thread to triage.

maya: seeing the same on dashboards, p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~480ms, p99 up to ~2.1s for gpt-small-ish workloads. Link to dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/alerts?id=6778 :rotating_light:

emily: we rolled a cost-weight tweak to the kernel selector at 03:00 to prefer lower-cost SDPA on medium-length sequences (seq 128-512). I suspected it might flip some cases but tests looked ok.

ben_sre: any customer impact from prior hour? SLA pager showed ~12 errors and elevated latencies across multiple regions (us-west1 + eu-west1). Can we get traces for a few p99 requests?

zoe_support: ticket #C-89342 from AcroPay flagged timeouts on chat flows starting 03:10 UTC. They saw retries and partial responses. I told them we're triaging.

arjun: sharing two p99 traces (redacted):
```
TRACE id=tx-7f3b2 seq=256 model=redwood/llm-v2 kernel=sdpa-quantized
start=2026-02-12T03:07:12Z
steps:
  - compile_kernel(sdpa-quantized) 120ms
  - alloc_kv_cache 95ms
  - attention_forward(sdpa-quantized) 980ms
  - send_tokens 10ms
total: 1215ms
ERROR: kv-cache stall detected
```

emily: that attention_forward number is the culprit — sdpa-quantized attention is taking ~1s on these traces. In internal perf runs SDPA was fine, but we may have mis-weighted the cost-model for this quant/seq combination.

maya: hypothesis: cost-model uses token_cost + kernel_setup amortization and we underestimated setup for midseq because compile/serialize path is heavier on gpu generation nodes when KV cache is hot. Might be an edge where FlashAttention would be faster despite higher per-token cost.

ben_sre: can we force a selector override for the affected customer/route while we investigate? Need immediate mitigation to restore p95.

emily: yes — two mitigation options: 1) pin kernel selector to prefer flashattn for seq 64–512 for chat_routes via runtime flag, or 2) roll back the cost-weight tweak. Option 1 is lower blast radius.

arjun: agree go with option 1. Please add a guarded runtime flag for the chat route and region filter. Post-mortem we can revisit cost weights.

emily: deploying override now. Command I used (internal):
```
# temp runtime override
rb deploy-config set runtime.kernel_selector.override.chat_route="prefer:flashattn;seq_range:64-512;expires:2026-02-12T06:30:00Z"
```

deploy_bot: deploy started by emily at 03:22 UTC — change id cfg-20260212-01 — rolling to us-west1/us-east1 first.

ben_sre: after override, p95 dropped to ~140ms in us-west1 within two rolling buckets. eu-west1 still warming — any plan for that region?

emily: rolling to eu-west1 now. Also enabling more verbose kernel selection debug for 1 hour to collect classifier scores.

arjun: request logs of kernel_selector.decisions for a sample set and full traces for 10 p99 requests pre-change/post-change. Also attach compile flags and GPU driver versions.

maya: I'm seeing classifier_score for SDPA drop when kv_cache_util > 0.7 — looks like the cost estimator assumes low KV share which made SDPA look cheaper. I'll capture snapshots.

zoe_support: contacting AcroPay to confirm mitigation helped — they say retries decreased and latency improved after ~03:30 UTC. Thanks.

emily: capture from debug logs: 
```
[03:05:11] selector: seq=256 costs: sdpa=0.18 flash=0.22 compile_overhead(sdpa)=0.35 classifier_score(sdpa)=0.44
[03:05:11] decision=sdpa
[03:05:12] kernel_exec(sdpa) latency=1023ms
```

arjun: action items:
- emily: keep override for 3 hours, then either stage a controlled rollback or a refined selector patch (ETA 6h).
- maya: run microbench matrix for sdpa vs flash across seq length [32,64,128,256,512] with kv_cache_util [0.0,0.5,0.9] and quant levels (fp16, q4_0, q4_1). Post results to this thread (ETA 4h).
- ben_sre: coordinate region rollouts and confirm p95/p99 graphs, collect 50 traces each pre/post.
- zoe_support: update tickets and advise customers of mitigation.

ben_sre: I'm starting a perf job now: /internal/run_perf --model llm-v2 --kernels sdpa,flash --seqs 32,64,128,256,512 --kv-util 0.0,0.5,0.9 --quant q4_0,q4_1,fp16 --runs 50 --traceout /tmp/kerneltune. Will attach artifacts.

emily: FYI compile flags we toggled in the cost-weight patch: ATTEN_OPT_LEVEL=2, SDPA_FUSION=1, FLASH_PREF_THRESHOLD=0.18. We may need to bump FLASH_PREF_THRESHOLD to 0.25 temporarily.

maya: preliminary perf result (quick local run): for seq=256 kv=0.9 q4_0 -> sdpa median=980ms, flash median=180ms. That's a big delta. Looks like SDPA compile path suffers with hot kv memory. Full matrix running.

arjun: if the matrix confirms, we should update the cost-model heuristics to include kv_cache_util multiplier and a stronger compile_overhead penalty for sdpa on q4 quant. Also add a safeguard: don't prefer sdpa when kv_cache_util>0.7 unless flash not available.

zoe_support: AcroPay acknowledged improvement. I'll close the critical header on their ticket and note the temporary workaround.

emily: plan to land a safe selector patch after matrix: change cost calc to cost = base_token_cost + compile_overhead*max(1,kv_util*2) and increase FLASH_PREF_THRESHOLD to 0.24. I'll open PR and tag arjun/maya for review.

arjun: thanks — keep this thread updated. We'll write a short postmortem template once the root cause is nailed.

ben_sre: reminding ops — schedule a follow-up check at 06:00 UTC to either remove override or confirm patch.

emily: posted PR #8172 with benchmark artifacts attached. Adding automated unit test to simulate kv_util=0.9 path.

maya: matrix finished and uploaded: /artifacts/kerneltune/1738809999-matrix.csv. Confirming patterns: sdpa regress on q4_0 at high kv_util for seq >=128. Will draft regression writeup.

arjun: great work team. Preliminary RCA: cost-model underestimates compile and kv-hot overhead for SDPA on certain quant/seq combos, causing selector to pick slower kernel. Mitigation: runtime override -> decreased customer impact. Next: selector patch + tests + postmortem.

zoe_support: I'll update internal status page and send customer note. :white_check_mark:

deploy_bot: cfg-20260212-01 override will expire at 2026-02-12T06:30:00Z unless extended.

arjun: closing slack triage for now — re-open if p99 creeps again or if regions show anomalies. Thanks all. :pray:
